note: Allowed wording. Rendition/ink/lockup/wordmark/usage come from SA Orchid Council Logo Presentation.pdf; NOS fragments come from the approved NOS filenames; bundle and quick-start wording from Codi's 2026-10-22 ruling.
usage_copy_verbatim: Clear space on all four sides equals one quarter of the emblem width. Nothing sets inside it.
Minimum emblem height is 24px on screen, 8mm in print. Below that the throat detail closes up and the mark should be set larger rather than simplified.
Set the lockup as a single object at the specified proportions, on parchment, bone or sage.
Do not re-space the gap, letter-space the wordmark, or shrink the emblem against the type.
Keep the vertical lockup's emblem flush to the wordmark width.
Do not float a small emblem above the name. It breaks the lockup.
